name: openslop
description: Open-source browser extension that hides AI-slop posts from your feed with a single sensitivity slider.

scripts.lint: eslint shared content popup tests background.js background.firefox.js playwright.config.js jest.config.js eslint.config.mjs --max-warnings=0
scripts.build: npm run build:chrome && npm run build:firefox
scripts.validate:extension: npm test -- tests/manifest.smoke.test.js --runInBand && npm test -- tests/build.artifacts.test.js --runInBand
scripts.verify:release: npm run typecheck && npm run lint:ci && npm run format:check && npm run check:no-console && npm run check:no-network && npm run audit:branding && npm run test:extension && npm run build:extension && npm run validate:extension && npm run test:e2e:extension
